frame.note: Interlace 2026.11.2 (apps/interlace/src/tui.rs `draw`): bottom-up the screen ends in a usage row, the state row, the input rows (`> ` then two spaces, up to 30% of the screen) and one notice row, which is blank while nothing is said. The blank notice row is the top edge. A notice, an approval's question, a picker's or the search's query on that row leaves no frame, so nothing is typed. The state row is the bottom edge only while it says `idle` or `working`: not `attaching`, not `waiting on an approval`, and not in the steer mode (` · steer · `), where Enter steers the turn instead of queueing.
